en.headline: Fire Services joint inspection finds five fire-hazard violations
en.dek: The department, working with Buildings Department and Labour Department, checked building structures, fire safety and worksite procedures and will follow up on blocked escape routes.
body: The Fire Services Department said a joint inspection with the Buildings Department and the Labour Department on Wednesday found five fire-hazard violations involving blocked escape routes and related issues.

The inspection covered building structures and fire safety in common areas as well as frontline construction procedures and occupational safety. Fourteen officers from the three departments took part.

The Fire Services Department will follow up and take enforcement action, including possible prosecution or the issue of fire-hazard abatement notices. It reminded contractors to maintain smoke-free sites and clear escape routes, and urged building management and owners to report hazards promptly.

zh.headline: 消防處聯同屋宇署勞工處巡查發現5項火警危險違規
zh.dek: 跨部門聯合巡查針對大廈公用地方結構、消防安全及前線施工，發現雜物阻塞逃生途徑等問題，將跟進執法。
body: 消防處聯同屋宇署及勞工處於周三展開跨部門聯合巡查，發現5項火警危險違規事項，主要涉及雜物阻塞逃生途徑。
巡查涵蓋大廈公用地方的樓宇結構與消防安全，以及前線施工程序和職安健層面，共動員14名人員。
消防處將持續跟進並採取執法行動，包括檢控或發出「消除火警危險通知書」。處方提醒承建商嚴守無煙地盤、妥善管理物料，業主及物管則應保持通道暢通並主動通報隱患。
